title: Simplify Algebraic Expressions
preview: Use properties of operations to create equivalent linear expressions; add, subtract, factor, and combine.
description: Indiana standard 7.AF.1. Students apply identity, inverse, commutative, associative, and distributive properties to rewrite linear expressions and justify each step.

sections.label: 5-1 Simplify Algebraic Expressions
sections.description: Apply properties of operations to rewrite linear expressions; justify each step.

sections.label: 5-2 Add Linear Expressions
sections.description: Combine like terms and add linear expressions.

sections.label: 5-3 Subtract Linear Expressions
sections.description: Subtract linear expressions, handling distributed negatives.

sections.label: 5-4 Factor Linear Expressions
sections.description: Factor out a common number from a linear expression (e.g., 2x − 10 = 2(x − 5)).

sections.label: 5-5 Combine Operations with Linear Expressions
sections.description: Multi-step expression manipulation that mixes addition, subtraction, and factoring.
